speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you haven't provided the patient's initial symptoms or history yet. Could you please describe exactly what gait and limb ataxia you are experiencing, and what significant medical history you have?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate your current dizziness or vertigo, and have you noticed any changes in your vision or hearing recently? Also, have you experienced any issues with bladder or bowel control?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to Natalizumab therapy.
